request.name: pypa-sampleproject-clean-boot
request.description: Install and exercise a public Python package from one exact commit, then inspect a behavior-bearing JSON artifact rather than trusting the test command alone.

commands.description: Build and install the exact checked-out sampleproject source tree.
Execute the repository's real unittest suite with verbose test identity.
Exercise add_one and retain a structured result for human inspection.
argv: import json,pathlib; from sample.simple import add_one; actual=add_one(41); result={"input":41,"actual":actual,"expected":42}; p=pathlib.Path("/tmp/blackridge-result.json"); p.write_text(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True)); print(p.read_text())

commands.description: Record the exact SWE-ReX server version inside the image.
Read effective Linux process and cgroup isolation limits.
argv: import json,pathlib; status=dict(line.split(':',1) for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/self/status').read_text().splitlines() if ':' in line); paths=['/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max','/sys/fs/cgroup/pids.max','/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max']; result={'CapEff':status.get('CapEff','').strip(),'NoNewPrivs':status.get('NoNewPrivs','').strip(),**{p:pathlib.Path(p).read_text().strip() if pathlib.Path(p).exists() else 'unavailable' for p in paths}}; print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
